title: Credential
description: A single vault entry (site login, API key, or other stored secret). The cross-feature source of truth for the Credential shape; feature 008 mirrors it as a runtime Zod schema (src/vault/credential.schema.ts) validated through safeParse at every boundary. Mock only in this feature: passwords are plain test strings, no encryption or persistence.

id.description: Stable UUID v4 assigned by the VaultStore on add.

username.description: Username or identifier for the credential.

domain.description: Site or service the credential belongs to.

password.description: The stored secret. Mock in this feature; real password material is out of scope until the storage/cryptography feature lands.

favorite.description: Whether the credential is pinned as a favorite.

notes.description: Free-form notes attached to the credential.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp assigned by the VaultStore on add.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp assigned by the VaultStore on update; absent on a freshly added credential.
